# Carve Creation

> Carve Creation is a project-based manufacturing partner for contract furniture, branding and wayfinding, architectural lighting, deployable spaces, and public art and sculpture for the built environment.

Carve Creation works with architects, interior designers, lighting designers, branding consultants, artists, developers, contractors, operators, procurement teams, and client organizations.

The company translates approved design intent into manufacturable products and coordinated built-environment packages. Its services may include technical development, material and finish coordination, samples, prototypes, manufacturing, milestone inspections, quality control, packaging, logistics, delivery, and installation coordination.

Carve Creation serves projects across the United States and Canada.

## Core Strengths

- Design Understanding: Carve Creation understands the intended aesthetic and translates it into practical materials, finishes, details, and fabrication methods.
- Manufacturing Precision: Precision equipment, DfMA-led development, samples, prototypes, and milestone-based quality inspections protect the approved standard through production.
- Project Transparency: Drawings, approvals, production updates, quality records, logistics, and project decisions can be tracked through the Carve Creation Project Portal.

## Core Capabilities

- [Contract Furniture](https://www.carvecreation.com/contract-furniture.html): Custom casegoods, seating, tables, banquettes, counters, built-ins, outdoor furniture, and coordinated furniture families.
- [Branding and Wayfinding](https://www.carvecreation.com/branding-wayfinding.html): Dimensional logos, identification signage, directories, directional signage, branded features, and coordinated wayfinding systems.
- [Architectural Lighting](https://www.carvecreation.com/architectural-lighting.html): Decorative fixtures, architectural lighting elements, feature lighting, custom chandeliers, pendants, sconces, and coordinated fixture families.
- [Carve Flex Deployable Spaces](https://www.carvecreation.com/deployable-spaces.html): Reusable interior environments and pods that can be purchased or leased, assembled, relocated, reconfigured, refurbished, and redeployed.
- [Public Art and Sculpture](https://www.carvecreation.com/public-sculpture.html): Site-specific sculpture, artist-designed installations, suspended artwork, interactive public art, architectural ornament, and other custom artistic fabrications.

## Project Delivery

Projects generally follow three stages:

1. Define and Approve
2. Manufacture and Verify
3. Deliver and Close Out

Complete construction documents are not required for an initial review. Carve Creation can begin with available drawings, schedules, specifications, quantities, reference images, location, budget, and target delivery timing.

## Selected Project Examples

- [H Hotel Los Angeles](https://www.carvecreation.com/project-h-hotel-los-angeles.html): More than 70 pieces of outdoor furniture for rooftop, pool, and amenity areas.
- [Virgin Hotels Las Vegas](https://www.carvecreation.com/project-virgin-hotels-las-vegas.html): Large-scale outdoor furniture package for the hotel pool area.
- [Din Tai Fung](https://www.carvecreation.com/project-din-tai-fung.html): Custom company logo signage for a restaurant in Santa Monica, California.
- [Conrad Los Angeles](https://www.carvecreation.com/project-conrad-los-angeles.html): Custom architectural lighting and sculptural artwork for the hotel club floor.
- [Loop](https://www.carvecreation.com/project-loop-iowa-city-pedestrian-mall.html): Interactive public artwork designed by Ekumen for the Iowa City Pedestrian Mall.
- [ZEISS Innovation Center](https://www.carvecreation.com/project-zeiss-innovation-center.html): Semi-open workplace pods in Dublin, California.
